en.askTitle: Put in your own degree, IELTS scores and budget to get the same Australian master’s comparison and honest cost check
en.runTitle: Vietnamese finance graduate planning an Australian master’s in 2027 on a family budget of about AUD 120,000

fields.label: Nationality and residence
fields.value: Vietnamese, living in Ho Chi Minh City

fields.label: Degree, institution, grades and graduation date
Intake preference
fields.value: February 2027, with July 2027 as the fallback if February is no longer realistic

fields.label: Written offers and net fees
fields.placeholder: e.g. a written Deakin offer with net tuition of AUD 36,000 a year after a 25% award

en.template: Compare Australian coursework master's routes for {nationality}, {degree}, {ielts}, {intake} and {budget}. Check course-specific international intake/deadlines, assessed duration, scholarship conditions and full-study living/visa/insurance costs. Compare {offers}, keep a funded backup and distinguish dated samples from confirmed terms. Plan only; do not apply, contact anyone, create accounts, book or pay.

phases.title: Check five programmes, the student visa rules, costs and scholarships on official pages
phases.note: Three Melbourne and two Sydney programmes
phases.judgment: It corrected a scholarship assumption that would have misled this applicant: Macquarie’s ASEAN A$10,000 scholarship excludes Vietnam, but its newer A$15,000-a-year Early Acceptance Scholarship explicitly covers Vietnamese citizens from 2027.

phases.title: Build the budget scenarios against AUD 120,000, the intake timeline and the guide
phases.note: Ten budget scenarios and a dated timeline
phases.judgment: It gave the unwelcome answer plainly: no scenario without a scholarship fits AUD 120,000, and the leanest Deakin route comes to about AUD 118,533 only if the conditions fall into place.

phases.title: Check content, sums and the rendered page, then deliver
phases.judgment: The open questions are left open: Deakin’s intake availability for this course could not be confirmed even after a second try, and Macquarie’s Vietnam-specific deadline wasn’t found. The independent reviewer also said it did not check how the page looks.

workers: Checked three Melbourne master’s programmes on the universities’ own pages: entry rules, 2027 fees, intake dates and scholarships
Checked two Sydney master’s programmes the same way, including application deadlines and living costs
Independently reviewed the plan, sampling the official pages it relies on and recomputing every budget row

zh.askTitle: 填入你自己的学历、雅思成绩和预算，就能得到同样的澳洲硕士比较和如实的费用核对
zh.runTitle: 越南金融专业毕业生计划 2027 年读澳洲硕士，家庭预算约 12 万澳元

fields.label: 学历、学校、成绩及毕业日期
入学偏好
fields.value: 2027 年 2 月入学；如果 2 月来不及，就改 2027 年 7 月

fields.label: 书面录取和净学费
fields.placeholder: 例如：迪肯大学的书面录取，获 25% 奖学金后净学费每年 3.6 万澳元

zh.template: 请按{nationality}、{degree}、{ielts}、{intake}及{budget}比较澳洲授课型硕士路线。核对具体课程的国际生开班及截止日、评估学制、奖学金条件，以及全学程生活、签证和保险费用。比较{offers}，保留资金可行的备选，分清有日期的例子与确认条款。只做规划，不申请、不联系、不开户、不预订、不付款。

phases.title: 在官方页面上核对五个项目、学生签证规定、费用和奖学金
phases.note: 墨尔本三个、悉尼两个项目
phases.judgment: 它纠正了一个会误导这位申请人的奖学金假设：麦考瑞大学的东盟 1 万澳元奖学金不包括越南，但新设的每年 1.5 万澳元早鸟奖学金明确面向 2027 年起的越南公民。

phases.title: 按 12 万澳元预算做费用情景、入学时间线和指南
phases.note: 十种预算情景和一条有日期的时间线
phases.judgment: 它直接给出了不那么好听的答案：不含奖学金的情景没有一个能压进 12 万澳元，最省的迪肯路线要条件都落实，才约 118,533 澳元。

phases.title: 核对内容、算术和页面效果，然后交付
phases.judgment: 没答案的问题就如实留着：迪肯这个项目的入学名额，试了第二遍仍没能确认；麦考瑞针对越南的截止日也没查到。独立复核同事还说明，它没有检查页面实际渲染的样子。

workers: 在大学自家页面上查了墨尔本三个硕士项目：入学条件、2027 年学费、开学日期和奖学金
用同样的办法查了悉尼两个硕士项目，包括申请截止日和生活费
独立审查这份规划：抽查它所依据的官方页面，并把预算的每一行重新算一遍
